IS 17545 : 2021 White Cement Based Polymeric Putty
ICS 87.040
CHD 20
New Standard from Last Update.1 SCOPEThis standard prescribes the requirements, methods of sampling and test for white cement based polymeric putty for use as a finished skim coat on internal or external plastered surfaces.2 REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes the requirements, methods of sampling and test for white cement based polymeric putty for use as a finished skim coat on internal or external plastered surfaces.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards indicated in Annex A.
